 *****
 Order

When the matter came up for hearing on 19.10.2023, it was informed by the learned Counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner died and therefore, in order to get instructions and to file application for substituting the legal heirs in the place of deceased petitioner, he sought some time.

Even today,
the learned Counsel for the petitioner has not received any information to substitute the legal representatives.
2.In view of the same, the Writ Petition stands dismissed as abated.
